title: ze_Dark_Souls
description:
This map was made for zombie escape mode 

 Almost a complete Remake of the original CSS map 

 Map includes: 

One large and long level, with a lot of secrets and traps

5 bosses with a new system called "Fear"

NPC's

3 different endings

14 human and 5 zm items ( Items Charges are now fully restored at bonfires, just approach with them to bonfire to restore charges on your items )

5 Custom skins for humans + 1 skin for mappers/helpers (regarding their activation, write to your service manager)

Health upgrade system and gain of human and zombie items - more charges and increased damage to bosses ( During the round you need to find special items to upgrade )

 If the map seems too easy for you, then you can activate the "Champion mode" next to Marvelous Chester or in a admin room 

 ᐅᐅIf you find a bug, please write about it in a special discussionᐊᐊ
